exclusion_criteria.DUPLICATE_TEXT: another contract in the corpus has byte-identical text
exclusion_criteria.NEAR_DUPLICATE_TEXT: the text is a near-duplicate of another contract (a re-executed or amended copy); including both would double-count one drafting style
exclusion_criteria.TEXT_TOO_SHORT: the contract is too short to carry the context claims a memo needs alongside the target claim
exclusion_criteria.REDACTED_TARGET_SPAN: the gold evidence span contains a redaction marker, so the text the case would be scored against is not the clause
exclusion_criteria.FRAGMENTED_EVIDENCE: the gold evidence is spread over more spans than the design admits, or a span is too short to be a clause statement
exclusion_criteria.STATUS_AMBIGUOUS: CUAD's own annotation is internally non-committal -- the impossible flag and the answer spans disagree -- so the gold status would need substantive legal interpretation to fix
exclusion_criteria.OFFSET_MISMATCH: the annotation's offsets do not reproduce its own text in the frozen context, so the case would be scored against the wrong characters
exclusion_criteria.UNMAPPABLE_TO_PARAGRAPH: the gold span overlaps no paragraph in the Gate-2.5 source layer, so the evidence metric could never register it
exclusion_criteria.BOTH_TARGETS_PRESENT: both target categories are present, so removing one would leave the case still carrying a policy trigger
exclusion_criteria.NO_NEUTRAL_REPLACEMENT: the contract offers fewer than four non-target clauses with usable evidence, so the memo could not be filled and the omitted claim could not be replaced by a clause the memo does not already carry
exclusion_criteria.TARGET_PRESENT_IN_SENTINEL_POOL: a sentinel must have both target clauses confirmed absent; this one has at least one present
exclusion_criteria.TARGET_ABSENT_IN_POSITIVE_POOL: a positive case must have its target clause present
exclusion_criteria.SENTINEL_NEAR_MISS_SCREEN: the negative sentinel contains contract language that may be a near-miss for a target category and is excluded before model runs
